dependencies.content:
[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.24"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "fraud-detection-gnn"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "Real-time transaction fraud detection using heterogeneous GNNs + agentic LLM investigation."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10,<3.13"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [
    { name = "Vivek Vasisht" },
]
keywords = ["fraud-detection", "gnn", "pytorch-geometric", "langgraph", "mlops"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Intended Audience :: Science/Research",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
    "Operating System :: OS Independent",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Artificial Intelligence",
]

dependencies = [
    # Core data stack (Phase 1)
    "numpy>=1.26,<2.3",
    "pandas>=2.1,<3.0",
    "pyarrow>=15.0",
    "scikit-learn>=1.4,<2.0",
    "scipy>=1.11",
    # Config + validation
    "pydantic>=2.10.6,<3.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.6",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
    "python-dotenv>=1.0",
    # Logging
    "structlog>=24.4",
    # Data download
    "kaggle>=1.6",
    # CLI
    "click>=8.1",
    # Progress / utilities
    "tqdm>=4.66",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0",
    "pytest-cov>=5.0",
    "pytest-mock>=3.14",
    "ruff>=0.6",
    "mypy>=1.11",
    "pre-commit>=3.8",
    "ipykernel>=6.29",
    "jupyter>=1.1",
    "matplotlib>=3.8",
    "seaborn>=0.13",
    "plotly>=5.24",
]

train = [
    # Phase 2/3 (stubbed here so `pip install -e .[train]` is forward-compatible)
    "torch>=2.10,<2.11",
    "torch-geometric>=2.5",
    "xgboost>=2.1",
    "networkx>=3.4.2",
    "mlflow>=2.16",
    "feast>=0.40",
    "optuna>=4.0",
]

serve = [
    # Phase 4
    "fastapi>=0.115.6",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.32",
    "ray[serve]>=2.37",
    "redis>=5.2.1",
    "confluent-kafka>=2.5",
    "shap>=0.46",
    "prometheus-client>=0.21",
]

agent = [
    # Phase 5
    "langgraph>=0.2.60",
    "langchain>=0.3.18",
    "langchain-ollama>=0.2",
    "langchain-community>=0.3",
    "langfuse>=2.52",
    "faiss-cpu>=1.8",
    "neo4j>=5.26",
]

monitor = [
    # Phase 7
    "evidently>=0.5",
    "prometheus-client>=0.21",
]

all = [
    "fraud-detection-gnn[dev,train,serve,agent,monitor]",
]

[project.scripts]
fraud-download = "fraud_detection.data.download:main"

[project.urls]
Repository = "https://github.com/ViVas970811/fraud-detection-gnn"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Hatchling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/fraud_detection"]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.sdist]
include = [
    "src/fraud_detection",
    "configs",
    "scripts",
    "README.md",
    "pyproject.toml",
]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ruff
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py310"
src = ["src", "tests", "scripts"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E", "W",   # pycodestyle
    "F",        # pyflakes
    "I",        # isort
    "B",        # flake8-bugbear
    "UP",       # pyupgrade
    "SIM",      # flake8-simplify
    "N",        # pep8-naming
    "C4",       # flake8-comprehensions
    "RUF",
]
ignore = [
    "E501",  # line length handled by formatter
    "N803",  # allow uppercase arg names (DataFrame convention)
    "N806",  # allow uppercase vars in functions (X, y)
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"tests/**" = ["N802"]  # allow test_ method names
"notebooks/**" = ["E402", "F401"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pytest
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "8.0"
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = [
    "-ra",
    "--strict-markers",
    "--strict-config",
]
markers = [
    "unit: fast, isolated unit tests",
    "integration: tests that require docker services",
    "e2e: end-to-end tests",
    "slow: tests taking more than a few seconds",
]
filterwarnings = [
    "ignore::DeprecationWarning:google.*",
    "ignore::PendingDeprecationWarning",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["src/fraud_detection"]
branch = true
omit = [
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/__init__.py",
    # Ray Serve deployment glue -- only exercised when a Ray cluster is up;
    # unit tests cannot reach it without standing up the cluster.
    "*/serving/ray_deployment.py",
]

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
]
show_missing = true
skip_covered = false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mypy
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.10"
strict = false
warn_unused_ignores = true
warn_redundant_casts = true
ignore_missing_imports = true

pandas==2.2.2

onnx>=1.16.0

# Experiment tracking / eval
mlflow>=2.13.0
evidently>=0.4.30

# Testing
pytest>=8.2.0
pytest-cov>=5.0.0
locust>=2.29.0
testcontainers>=4.4.0
httpx>=0.27.0

# Utilities
kaggle
python-dotenv>=1.0.0

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "driftline"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.10"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 110

[tool.ruff.lint]
# BLE001 (blind `except Exception`) is intentionally allowed: this codebase uses it deliberately
# for availability checks (Docker daemon reachable? Feast store reachable?) where any failure
# mode should be treated the same way -- fall back / mark unavailable -- not for swallowing bugs.
ignore = ["BLE001"]
